notes.title: New Grey Phobia update !
notes.content:
Difficulty mode added - more hardcore, more casual:
enemies now dying behind the player on casual mode all you need only leave them behind and they will not bother you!

More drop added on some levels that you can easely pass to the final survival levels.

notes.title: Grey phobia update is coming soon !
notes.content:
We noticed that this update extremely needed!

Update will contain:

1. Speed fix.
2. UI fix.
3. Tutorials will be added.
4. Comics autoskip removed.
5. Spider kill modification - spiders will not kill player in first levels.
6. Spiders damage marker - allows you to see safe distance from spider.
7. Weapon range markers added - allows you to see weapons range trajectory.
8. Couple various fixes.

***************

Notice If you have trouble with the speed it depends on the energy- this will be fixed.
And if you try to kill spiders they will be invincible. but you can force them to pull back with the rifle - long range. Just shoot him when you see his head. While he's uncovered.
